quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
يسٓ
وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

subchannels.active_motifs: recitation (quranic:root_001210:B002/m01); accurate wisdom (quranic:root_000348:B003/m01); firm construction (quranic:root_000348:B004/m01); released dispatch (quranic:root_000563:B001/m01); carried message (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); delivered descent (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); danger-awakening warning (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); straight road (quranic:root_000858:B001/m01); upright alignment (quranic:root_001273:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The signal begins as ordered recitation, is secured by discriminating and well-fastened wisdom, and is borne by a messenger rather than left as free-floating information. Descent supplies delivery, warning gives the delivery its activating function, and the straight, upright road supplies its intended trajectory.

subchannels.name: Tracking a reminder beyond sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recipient follows a prior trace, restores it to memory, and responds with awe even though the object remains visually absent.
subchannels.active_motifs: following in another's wake (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); trace-by-trace pursuit (quranic:root_000175:B003/m01); recalled memory (quranic:root_000516:B003/m01); reminder that restores presence (quranic:root_000516:B009/m01); awe-filled fear (quranic:root_000413:B001/m01); concealment from eyes (quranic:root_001117:B001/m01); news that opens the skin with joy (quranic:root_000120:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Reception is modeled as disciplined tracking rather than passive hearing. The reminder makes an absent referent present to memory; awe operates without visual possession, and the final message registers somatically as a brightened, opened surface.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A source releases an ordered signal that reaches a route, then becomes effective only when a hearer tracks and retains it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:2-6 anchors the recited revelation, wisdom, messengership, straight path, descent, and warning, while 36:10-11 contrasts refused warning with following the reminder.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Recitation is not only speech but an act of gathering, while wisdom supplies both exact judgment and the restraining function of guidance.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Constrained Passage

subchannels.name: Rein, neck, yoke, and raised chin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A head-control apparatus closes around the neck, braces the chin, and fixes the head in a non-drinking, non-navigating posture.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraining rein around the jaws (quranic:root_000348:B006/m01); neck and collar-bearing member (quranic:root_001053:B001/m01); iron or leather yoke (quranic:root_001102:B006/m01); chin as jaw-junction (quranic:root_000515:B001/m01); support forced under the chin (quranic:root_000515:B006/m01); head raised away from water (quranic:root_001254:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene resolves into a complete control mechanism: a rein governs the jaws, a yoke grips the neck, a brace occupies the chin, and the resulting head-angle prevents ordinary lowering toward water. The surface image of disbelief is thereby materialized as forced posture and failed access.

subchannels.name: Blocked horizon
subchannels.scene_or_process: Barriers occupy threshold, front, and rear positions while a cover removes the remaining visual channel.
subchannels.active_motifs: road-blocking partition (quranic:root_000687:B001/m01); obstructed threshold (quranic:root_000687:B004/m01); rearward position (quranic:root_000433:B002/m01); what lies ahead (quranic:root_001693:B008/m01); overlying visual cover (quranic:root_001088:B001/m01); ocular sight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The body is not merely lost on a road. The road is architecturally closed at its threshold and on both directional axes; then the visual sensor is covered. Spatial obstruction and perceptual obstruction cooperate as one engineered scene of non-reception.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Orientation is disabled by controlling the body's angle or sealing the spatial field through which it could advance and see.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:8 fixes necks and chins, while 36:9 blocks front and rear and covers sight.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same lexical field that gives wisdom the function of a rein also exposes how guidance can be inverted into a yoke that prevents motion.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Recovery of What Has Passed

subchannels.name: Reactivating still life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A state of lost force and sleep-like stillness is reversed into preserved or rain-like life.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain-revived earth (quranic:root_000383:B002/m01); life spared from killing (quranic:root_000383:B006/m01); loss of force and life (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); stillness like sleep or decay (quranic:root_001454:B012/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Death is given both a terminal sense and a dormant, windless or sleep-like sense. Life answers it as preservation and as the return of fertility, so revival becomes a transition from arrested potential to active presence.

subchannels.name: Enrolling deeds and traces
subchannels.scene_or_process: Acts sent ahead and marks left behind are joined into writing, entered in a roster, counted, and exposed by an authoritative guide-record.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining pieces into a whole (quranic:root_001283:B001/m01); ordered written characters (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); binding decree (quranic:root_001283:B003/m01); entry in a register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); advance into the foreground (quranic:root_001207:B004/m01); surviving mark (quranic:root_000011:B003/m01); path of a predecessor's trace (quranic:root_000011:B004/m01); counting pebble (quranic:root_000332:B001/m01); exhaustive enumeration (quranic:root_000332:B002/m01); guiding exemplar and construction line (quranic:root_000053:B009/m01); disclosed evidence (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Forward acts and surviving traces occupy opposite temporal directions but converge in one evidentiary apparatus. Writing joins discrete units, the roster fixes identity, pebble-counting exhausts quantity, and the imam functions at once as guide, book, and line by which a structure is kept true.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What has fallen out of active presence can be returned either to life or to a legible evidentiary state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:12 joins revival of the dead to writing prior acts, surviving traces, enumeration, and an encompassing register.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The ledger is materially imagined as joined pieces, a roster, and pebbles counted one by one, making resurrection and record retrieval parallel operations of re-presentation.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Reinforced Relay and Counter-Speech

subchannels.name: A relay completed by reinforcement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A city receives a carried example and messenger pair; a third member completes and strengthens the chain until the message reaches its addressee clearly.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken example (quranic:root_001397:B003/m01); companioned group (quranic:root_000844:B001/m01); people gathered in a settlement (quranic:root_001222:B001/m01); arrival at a destination (quranic:root_000281:B001/m01); released envoy (quranic:root_000563:B001/m01); message and its carrier (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); one joined to one as a pair (quranic:root_000208:B001/m01); third member that completes two (quranic:root_000203:B003/m01); strengthening one by another (quranic:root_001008:B004/m01); delivered message (quranic:root_000151:B002/m01); speech that reaches its aim (quranic:root_000151:B004/m01); semantic disclosure (quranic:root_000170:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The relay has a social setting, carriers, numerical architecture, reinforcement, and an endpoint. Pairing first supplies redundancy; the third does not merely increase count but completes and fortifies the message-bearing unit, whose task is to reach and disclose rather than compel assent.

subchannels.name: Words become contagion and stones
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rejection spreads as agitated omen-talk, hardens into injurious verbal projectiles, and culminates in expulsion, bodily impact, and punishment.
subchannels.active_motifs: false statement (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); accusation of lying (quranic:root_001290:B002/m01); verbal contest over an affair (quranic:root_001272:B009/m01); rapid dispersal (quranic:root_000962:B002/m01); impulsive agitation (quranic:root_000962:B005/m01); harmful speech as thrown stones (quranic:root_000547:B002/m01); cursing and expulsion (quranic:root_000547:B003/m01); defensive combat for a group (quranic:root_000547:B007/m01); harmful impact reaching the body (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); felt suffering (quranic:root_000046:B001/m01); transgression beyond limit (quranic:root_000699:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The counter-message first travels lightly and diffusely as charged omen-talk, then acquires projectile weight. The threatened stoning is already prepared by language whose abuse is itself a form of pelting; expulsion, defended group identity, touch, and pain complete a single escalation from utterance to coercive impact.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech becomes social force through relays, additions, and the way one utterance recruits a response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:13-17 builds and reinforces the messenger relay, while 36:18-19 converts response into accusation, threat, and punitive speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Numerical addition strengthens the relay, whereas hostile language becomes airborne contagion and then a stone-like projectile.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Hospitality and Rescue

subchannels.name: Adopted protectors that cannot extract
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person acquires subordinate deities as supposed shields, but their advocacy cannot suffice or pull him from the grip of harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: acquisition for oneself (quranic:root_000018:B010/m01); subordinate other (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); worshiped object (quranic:root_000047:B001/m01); directed will (quranic:root_000610:B001/m01); loss and harm (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); advocate joining a claimant (quranic:root_000802:B002/m01); substitute sufficiency (quranic:root_001110:B002/m01); extraction from another's grip (quranic:root_001540:B001/m01); captured object recovered from an enemy (quranic:root_001540:B002/m01); protective shield (quranic:root_000266:B008/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene tests protection operationally. Possession and cultic status do not make an effective shield: the proposed advocates cannot stand beside the endangered person with sufficient force, nor can they extract a captive from another power.

subchannels.name: Sheltered reception
subchannels.scene_or_process: The rejected witness is admitted into an interior garden, covered from the effects of fault, nurtured, and installed among the honored.
subchannels.active_motifs: guest-feeding hospitality (quranic:root_001222:B003/m01); entry into an interior (quranic:root_000464:B001/m01); protected inward space (quranic:root_000464:B003/m01); tree-screened garden (quranic:root_000266:B003/m01); preserving cover (quranic:root_001096:B001/m01); forgiveness that shields from consequence (quranic:root_001096:B002/m01); care that repairs and completes (quranic:root_000532:B002/m01); bestowed honor (quranic:root_001294:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: What the city fails to provide as host is supplied by the garden. Entry changes exposure into interiority, forgiveness functions as a preserving cover, and lordly care completes the transfer from rejected outsider to honored guest.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Legitimate protection is shown by the ability to admit, shelter, and extract a vulnerable person from harm.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:23 denies rescue and intercession to adopted gods, while 36:26-27 grants entry, forgiveness, and honor.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The rejecting village carries a latent duty of feeding the guest, whereas the garden becomes the true place of reception and protective covering.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Social Presence after Erasure

subchannels.name: Generations removed from return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A time-bound population falls into destruction and can no longer return to the later community.
subchannels.active_motifs: fall into destruction (quranic:root_001596:B001/m01); prior position in sequence (quranic:root_001198:B002/m01); people joined in one age (quranic:root_001221:B005/m01); return to an originating state or direction (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The generation is defined as a population co-present in one time. Destruction removes that whole layer from lateral return to those who follow it.

subchannels.name: Total reassembly into presence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed persons are exhaustively collected into one witnessed body.
subchannels.active_motifs: encompassing totality (quranic:root_001315:B003/m01); collection of what was dispersed (quranic:root_000259:B001/m01); crowd gathered by one direction (quranic:root_000259:B002/m01); close witnessed presence (quranic:root_000333:B001/m01); present collective (quranic:root_000333:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The second operation reverses dispersion without restoring the old historical relation. Every discrete member is collected, and the result is not merely a crowd but a body made immediately present for encounter.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Collective bodies can disappear from one field of relation yet be gathered into another field of compulsory presence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:31 removes earlier generations from return to their successors, and 36:32 gathers everyone into presence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Historical absence and eschatological assembly are opposite operations on the same social body.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Regenerative Production

subchannels.name: Hydraulic cultivation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fertile but dead ground is revived, opened, watered through fissures and springs, and made into a screened orchard bearing grain, palms, and grapes.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); fertile soft earth (quranic:root_000025:B002/m01); uncultivated dead land (quranic:root_001454:B003/m01); earth revived by rain and plants (quranic:root_000383:B002/m01); extraction from concealment (quranic:root_000400:B002/m01); germinating seed (quranic:root_000286:B001/m01); tree-screened orchard (quranic:root_000266:B003/m01); palm tree (quranic:root_001483:B001/m01); grape fruit (quranic:root_001050:B001/m01); wide water fissure (quranic:root_001132:B001/m01); flowing spring (quranic:root_001069:B006/m01); river cut through earth (quranic:root_001559:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The mechanism begins with latent capacity in soft ground. Revival opens what was sealed, seed emerges, water receives channels through fissure and spring, and the result is not isolated vegetation but a tree-covered productive enclosure.

subchannels.name: Harvest, handwork, and responsive increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mature yield is eaten, shaped by deliberate handwork, and answered by a gratitude that itself resembles visible biological increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: ripened fruit (quranic:root_000205:B001/m01); eating (quranic:root_000043:B001/m01); crop yield (quranic:root_000043:B002/m01); intentional work (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); manual workers (quranic:root_001046:B006/m01); deed attributed to hands (quranic:root_001693:B009/m01); recognition of benefit (quranic:root_000810:B001/m01); little input producing visible growth (quranic:root_000810:B002/m01); fresh shoots (quranic:root_000810:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Fruit is both natural output and the terminus of intentional labor. Gratitude does not sit outside the production scene: its lexical image is a creature or plant that visibly flourishes from little provision, so acknowledgment becomes another form of responsive yield.

subchannels.name: Paired propagation across kinds
subchannels.scene_or_process: Generative entities are coupled, classified, cultivated, and extended from plant growth to human maturation and living selves.
subchannels.active_motifs: member of a pair (quranic:root_000652:B001/m01); pair-making (quranic:root_000652:B003/m01); differentiated kind (quranic:root_000652:B004/m01); plant emergence (quranic:root_001465:B001/m01); deliberate cultivation (quranic:root_001465:B002/m01); human growth and upbringing (quranic:root_001465:B006/m01); living self (quranic:root_001533:B011/m01); knowledge that discloses kinds (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Pairing is a productive rule rather than only a marital label. It sorts kinds, couples participants, and allows the emergence process to run through plants, persons, and forms not yet disclosed to human knowledge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hidden substrate is opened, organized, and made repeatedly productive as water, crop, nourishment, and new life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:33-36 moves from dead earth through water, grain, orchard, fruit, labor, gratitude, and paired growth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gratitude shares the agronomic logic of a field that turns a small input into visible increase.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Layered Time and Celestial Traffic

subchannels.name: Stripping the day-layer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A temporal covering is peeled away like hide or clothing, exposing the darkness beneath.
subchannels.active_motifs: night and its darkness (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); skin stripped from a body (quranic:root_000729:B001/m01); garment removed (quranic:root_000729:B002/m01); time-layer reaching its end (quranic:root_000729:B003/m01); daylight opened by illumination (quranic:root_001559:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Night is not generated after day departs; it is exposed when the bright layer is peeled away. Hide, clothing, and expired time converge on one operation of removing an outer temporal surface.

subchannels.name: Solar route and station
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sun flows along a habitual route toward a stable terminus fixed by measured planning.
subchannels.active_motifs: sun and its light (quranic:root_000818:B001/m01); flowing motion (quranic:root_000240:B001/m01); habitual route (quranic:root_000240:B002/m01); stable station (quranic:root_001215:B003/m01); bounded measure (quranic:root_001205:B001/m01); calculated ordering (quranic:root_001205:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Motion and rest are coordinated rather than opposed. Flow follows a recurrent way, the station supplies a terminus, and measured planning keeps both route and endpoint within one calibrated system.

subchannels.name: Lunar stages and non-collision
subchannels.scene_or_process: The moon returns through assigned stations, visibly ages into a curved remnant, and shares an orbit whose race rules prevent overtaking.
subchannels.active_motifs: moon and moonlight (quranic:root_001255:B001/m01); assigned station or stage (quranic:root_001492:B003/m01); return after departure (quranic:root_001058:B001/m01); curved dry palm-stalk (quranic:root_000998:B001/m01); ancient duration (quranic:root_001207:B003/m01); catching a moving object (quranic:root_000471:B001/m01); racing advance (quranic:root_000671:B001/m01); escape from a pursuer (quranic:root_000671:B004/m01); circular motion (quranic:root_001177:B001/m01); celestial track (quranic:root_001177:B002/m01); swimming through air or space (quranic:root_000666:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Lunar change is made legible as both route and aging object. The dry curved stalk is a retained trace of a completed growth cycle; stations regulate recurrence, while catch, race, orbit, and swimming define a traffic system in which each body moves without seizing the other's lane.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Time is organized by removable layers and measured tracks that let moving bodies share a system without collision.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:37 strips day from night, and 36:38-40 assigns sun and moon measured stations, sequence, orbit, and motion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Daylight behaves like a skin or garment, while the aging palm stalk turns lunar time into a visible material remnant.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Carriage under Hazard

subchannels.name: Loaded vessel and entrusted cargo
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed descendants are lifted into a filled circular vessel, layered as cargo, borne by a vehicle, and ordered by a captain.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying on a vessel (quranic:root_000357:B001/m01); entrusted load (quranic:root_000357:B003/m01); carrying vehicle (quranic:root_000357:B006/m01); dispersed minute particles (quranic:root_000511:B001/m01); completed load (quranic:root_000780:B001/m01); water-circling ship (quranic:root_001177:B003/m01); rider on vessel or mount (quranic:root_000589:B001/m01); layered cargo (quranic:root_000589:B002/m01); functional counterpart (quranic:root_001397:B001/m01); captain of sailors (quranic:root_000532:B017/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The ship is a complete carrying mechanism, not a bare symbol: it has vehicle, load, layering, passengers, analogous successors, and a pilot role. Tiny dispersed lineage is consolidated into entrusted cargo, making preservation depend on ordered carriage.

subchannels.name: Engulfment, distress call, and timed reprieve
subchannels.scene_or_process: Waves occupy the vessel's field, water engulfs its occupants, a cry seeks extraction, and only enclosing mercy extends usable time.
subchannels.active_motifs: agitated wave (quranic:root_001177:B007/m01); fatal submersion (quranic:root_001080:B001/m01); ground or eye filled with water (quranic:root_001080:B003/m01); high distress cry (quranic:root_000855:B001/m01); call for rescue (quranic:root_000855:B002/m01); answering rescue (quranic:root_000855:B003/m01); extraction from danger (quranic:root_001540:B001/m01); compassionate mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01); womb-like enclosure (quranic:root_000552:B003/m01); usable benefit (quranic:root_001395:B001/m01); extended respite (quranic:root_001395:B007/m01); bounded time (quranic:root_000382:B001/m01); waiting for the appointed time (quranic:root_000382:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Hazard is a change of medium: the water that normally bears the vessel fills every available field and turns carriage into engulfment. The human scene supplies both sides of the rescue call, but the surface denies an answering rescuer; mercy instead acts as an enclosing vessel that keeps life usable for a measured interval.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A carrying system holds a dispersed lineage together only while structure, guidance, and rescue keep water from becoming an engulfing field.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:41-44 gives the loaded vessel, riders, drowning, failed cry, mercy, and respite, while 36:46 supplies a latent sailor-captain anchor within P3.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Descendants become seed-like particles gathered into cargo, and the root of lordship contributes the specialized role of a captain of sailors.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Ethical Throughput

subchannels.name: An arriving sign turned to the side
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protection is offered across the field ahead and behind; a sign arrives, but the recipient rotates its side away from the incoming marker.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective barrier against harm (quranic:root_001677:B001/m01); placing oneself under protection (quranic:root_001677:B002/m01); interval between positions (quranic:root_000170:B002/m01); what lies ahead (quranic:root_001693:B008/m01); what lies behind (quranic:root_000433:B002/m01); arrival (quranic:root_000009:B001/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); side of an object (quranic:root_001001:B001/m01); turning the side away (quranic:root_001001:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The sign has a direction of approach, and protection spans the recipient's temporal-spatial field. Refusal is a bodily rotation: instead of receiving the incoming marker, the addressee presents a side and breaks the channel.

subchannels.name: Provision that must pass through
subchannels.scene_or_process: An allotted food-resource enters possession, should exit through expenditure and feeding, but is blocked by denial and loss of direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: money flowing outward (quranic:root_001537:B002/m01); tunnel with an outlet (quranic:root_001537:B003/m01); allotted gift (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); sustaining food (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); eating and tasting (quranic:root_000934:B001/m01); feeding another (quranic:root_000934:B002/m01); livelihood and hospitality (quranic:root_000934:B004/m01); settled trust (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); covering a benefit (quranic:root_001307:B004/m01); covering seed with soil (quranic:root_001307:B008/m01); departure from the right route (quranic:root_000913:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Provision is a throughput system. Allocation and food enter; expenditure opens an outlet; feeding carries the resource to another body. Denial covers the received good like seed under soil but suppresses its expected emergence, so the blocked flow becomes ethical misdirection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A received good remains life-giving only when it is admitted, protected, and passed onward rather than turned aside or covered.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:45-47 moves from protection and arriving signs to refusal, provision, expenditure, feeding, faith, and denial.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Expenditure behaves like an open tunnel, while ingratitude behaves like a cultivator covering seed but refusing the growth that should follow.

parent_channels.name: P4 - Pneumatic Mobilization

subchannels.name: Horn-blast, waking, and grave-exit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath enters a horn, sleepers are stirred from fixed grave-rest, and separated bodies stream rapidly toward an already appointed encounter.
subchannels.active_motifs: wind sent into an object (quranic:root_001529:B001/m01); blowing horn (quranic:root_000891:B004/m01); grave enclosure (quranic:root_000226:B001/m01); stirring a sleeper (quranic:root_000129:B001/m01); collective surge (quranic:root_000129:B004/m01); sleep and stillness (quranic:root_000585:B001/m01); fixed residence (quranic:root_000585:B003/m01); accelerated rejection of sleep (quranic:root_000585:B004/m01); rapid movement (quranic:root_001499:B002/m01); separation and emergence (quranic:root_001499:B003/m01); appointed time or place (quranic:root_001662:B003/m01); fulfilled promise (quranic:root_000852:B004/m01); carried messenger-word (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Breath activates an instrument; the instrument activates bodies. Grave and sleep supply enclosure and stillness, while stirring, accelerated waking, emergence, and rapid movement form the release sequence. The appointment and messenger-word show that this sudden motion was already temporally routed.

subchannels.name: One signal gathers all
subchannels.scene_or_process: A single alarming sound aligns dispersed persons in one direction, collects them, and makes them a present body.
subchannels.active_motifs: loud call (quranic:root_000895:B001/m01); alarming cry (quranic:root_000895:B002/m01); numerical one (quranic:root_001631:B002/m01); unification in one direction (quranic:root_001631:B005/m01); collection of dispersed members (quranic:root_000259:B001/m01); gathered crowd (quranic:root_000259:B002/m01); witnessed proximity (quranic:root_000333:B001/m01); present collective (quranic:root_000333:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Numerical singularity produces social totality. One signal supplies a common vector; gathering then converts dispersed persons into a collective whose defining state is immediate presence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A concentrated acoustic or pneumatic signal converts enclosed stillness into rapid collective presence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:51-53 joins horn-blast, graves, rapid emergence, waking, fulfilled warning, one cry, gathering, and presentation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sleep vocabulary contributes both fixed residence and its sudden opposite, accelerated activity.

parent_channels.name: P4 - Embodied Accounting

subchannels.name: Exact settlement of action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A decisive event-day fixes each self to its act and settles the account without moving a right from its proper holder.
subchannels.active_motifs: severe event-day (quranic:root_001700:B003/m01); wrongful displacement (quranic:root_000967:B004/m01); withholding a right (quranic:root_000967:B008/m01); self as the thing itself (quranic:root_001533:B012/m01); reciprocal compensation (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); one thing standing for another (quranic:root_000244:B002/m01); debt settlement (quranic:root_000244:B003/m01); intentional act (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); acquired earning (quranic:root_001296:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Justice is modeled as correct placement and settlement. No right is shifted out of position; act, actor, and compensating return remain aligned as in an account whose debt is exactly discharged.

subchannels.name: Sealed mouth, evidentiary limbs
subchannels.scene_or_process: The normal speech aperture is sealed, while hands and feet become witnesses whose marks and earnings speak from the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: seal-imprint (quranic:root_000393:B002/m01); speech-preventing seal (quranic:root_000393:B003/m01); open mouth (quranic:root_001190:B001/m01); mouth-produced speech (quranic:root_001190:B003/m01); intelligible exchange (quranic:root_001316:B001/m01); bodily wound as a word-mark (quranic:root_001316:B003/m01); hand as limb (quranic:root_001693:B001/m01); deed attributed to hands (quranic:root_001693:B009/m01); witnessed presence (quranic:root_000822:B001/m01); informed testimony (quranic:root_000822:B002/m01); tongue as witness (quranic:root_000822:B005/m01); evidentiary mark (quranic:root_000822:B008/m01); foot as limb (quranic:root_000546:B001/m01); earning limb (quranic:root_001296:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Sealing does not end testimony; it reallocates the speaking role. Hands carry deeds, feet embody movement, and both become present witnesses. The lexical overlap between word and wound makes bodily history resemble a set of legible marks that cannot be overruled by the mouth.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conduct remains attached to the actor and can be converted into exact compensation and bodily testimony.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:54 states non-displacement and recompense for work, while 36:65 seals mouths and makes hands and feet testify to earnings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A word can also be a wound, so the body's speaking limbs resemble inscribed marks left by action.

parent_channels.name: P4 - Assigned Stations

subchannels.name: Sheltered repose and convivial provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Companions and spouses abide beneath a protective canopy, recline on fitted couches, eat fruit, exchange pleasant speech, and receive peace under sustaining care.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship (quranic:root_000844:B001/m01); protection through company (quranic:root_000844:B002/m01); screened garden (quranic:root_000266:B003/m01); absorbing occupation (quranic:root_000801:B001/m01); delighted state (quranic:root_001174:B001/m01); pleasant fruit (quranic:root_001174:B002/m01); convivial speech (quranic:root_001174:B003/m01); marital pair (quranic:root_000652:B002/m01); shade (quranic:root_000966:B001/m01); overhead canopy (quranic:root_000966:B003/m01); protective shelter (quranic:root_000966:B004/m01); couch in an enclosure (quranic:root_000026:B004/m01); abiding in place (quranic:root_000026:B003/m01); supported reclining (quranic:root_001678:B004/m01); call that draws provision near (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); safety (quranic:root_000737:B001/m01); peace opposed to war (quranic:root_000737:B004/m01); completing care (quranic:root_000532:B002/m01); compassionate mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The garden is assembled as a complete habitat: social company, paired household, canopy, couch, posture, food, call, speech, and care. Its invariant is supported ease, in which every spatial and social component preserves rather than exposes the occupant.

subchannels.name: Separation into punitive heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Offenders are cut out from the collective by their acquired offense and placed in fire whose heat seizes and reshapes.
subchannels.active_motifs: sorting from a mixed body (quranic:root_001461:B001/m01); separation as cutting (quranic:root_001461:B002/m01); severing operation (quranic:root_000239:B001/m01); acquired culpability (quranic:root_000239:B003/m01); crime and transgression (quranic:root_000239:B004/m01); encounter with fire (quranic:root_000880:B003/m01); heat used to straighten material (quranic:root_000880:B004/m01); covering and concealment (quranic:root_001307:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Separation is both classificatory and cutting. What offenders have acquired identifies them, division removes them from the former body, and fire becomes the fitted medium of their new station, with heat carrying a severe material sense of straightening.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment materializes as a fitted place, posture, company, and sensory state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:55-58 installs the garden company in fruit, shade, couches, and peace, while 36:59 and 36:63-64 separate offenders into fire.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The two destinations are not abstract rewards but opposed spatial technologies: canopy and support versus cutting separation and heat-straightening.

parent_channels.name: P4 - Covenant and Route

subchannels.name: Preserved instruction on a leveled road
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prior instruction is entrusted across generations, retained as covenant, enacted as service, and embodied in a traveled, upright road.
subchannels.active_motifs: maintained care over time (quranic:root_001055:B001/m01); entrusted injunction (quranic:root_001055:B002/m01); protected pact (quranic:root_001055:B003/m01); remembered prior encounter (quranic:root_001055:B004/m01); descendants from an origin (quranic:root_000156:B007/m01); obedient worship (quranic:root_000973:B003/m01); leveled traveled road (quranic:root_000973:B005/m01); straight path (quranic:root_000858:B001/m01); upright alignment (quranic:root_001273:B008/m01); reason that restrains ignorance (quranic:root_001036:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The covenant is a kept deposit rather than a momentary command. It travels through descendants, is enacted in service, and takes spatial form as a road made passable and straight; reason is the internal restraint that keeps the traveler from leaving it.

subchannels.name: Hostile tether and mass diversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remote rebel uses a strong crooked tether to pull a great ingrained mass from its route toward loss, disappearance, and false refuge.
subchannels.active_motifs: remoteness and severance (quranic:root_000796:B001/m01); long binding rope (quranic:root_000796:B002/m01); crooked resistance (quranic:root_000796:B003/m01); rebellious figure (quranic:root_000796:B004/m01); transgressive overstepping (quranic:root_000993:B001/m01); enemy relation (quranic:root_000993:B003/m01); side or bank that departs from the course (quranic:root_000993:B009/m01); deviation from a route (quranic:root_000913:B001/m01); disappearance into concealment (quranic:root_000913:B002/m01); loss of possession or location (quranic:root_000913:B003/m01); mountain-like multitude (quranic:root_000217:B002/m01); ingrained created nature (quranic:root_000217:B004/m01); coercion into an act (quranic:root_000217:B010/m01); numerical abundance (quranic:root_001286:B001/m01); animal tether (quranic:root_001036:B002/m01); fortified refuge (quranic:root_001036:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Diversion has an opponent, instrument, mass, and destination. The enemy is lexically distant and crooked, the tether supplies control, the mountain-like multitude supplies resistant bulk, and misguidance shifts that mass from the road to a side-field where loss can masquerade as refuge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A preserved allegiance keeps a traveler on an open, leveled route; rival allegiance tethers, bends, and displaces.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:60-62 moves from a prior covenant and worship to the straight path, hostile diversion, a great multitude, and failed reasoning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reason and worship both carry animal-management imagery: one can restrain by a guiding tether, while false service turns the road and traveler into subdued equipment.

parent_channels.name: P4 - Erasure of Navigational Agency

subchannels.name: Eye and track erased
subchannels.scene_or_process: Visual light and the path's trace are wiped out, so competitive forward motion has neither sensor nor readable course.
subchannels.active_motifs: erased trace (quranic:root_000950:B001/m01); extinguished sight-light (quranic:root_000950:B002/m01); terrain without a path (quranic:root_000950:B004/m01); seeing eye (quranic:root_001069:B001/m01); racing advance (quranic:root_000671:B001/m01); failure to catch or reach (quranic:root_000671:B004/m01); straight path (quranic:root_000858:B001/m01); question of route and manner (quranic:root_000063:B005/m01); ocular sight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The operation deletes both map and reader. The eye loses light, the ground loses its trace, and racing becomes futile because speed cannot compensate for a pathless field.

subchannels.name: Recast in place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily form, sensory quality, and vigor are altered at a fixed station until neither onward passage nor reversal remains possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: transformation into a worse form (quranic:root_001421:B001/m01); loss of taste or color (quranic:root_001421:B002/m01); bodily wasting (quranic:root_001421:B003/m01); fixed place or rank (quranic:root_001332:B002/m01); capacity for action (quranic:root_000956:B003/m01); passage and forward motion (quranic:root_001430:B001/m01); return to an earlier state (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Here the route remains conceptually available, but the traveler is altered. Recasting fixes the body to its station and removes the paired capacities that define navigation: proceeding and returning.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Agency can be removed by deleting the sensor and track or by recasting the body so it cannot leave its assigned place.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:66 erases eyes and defeats racing on the path, while 36:67 transforms bodies in place and removes both advance and return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Optical deletion, archival erasure, pathlessness, and bodily deformation are parallel ways of removing a recoverable route.

parent_channels.name: P5 - Message that Keeps Life Addressable

subchannels.name: Marked remembrance rather than poetic fabrication
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fine perception and visible marks are gathered into recitation, retained as remembrance, spoken, and made clear without becoming poetic craft.
subchannels.active_motifs: disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); guiding mark (quranic:root_001040:B002/m01); fine awareness (quranic:root_000798:B005/m01); ritual or identifying sign (quranic:root_000798:B006/m01); composed poetry (quranic:root_000798:B007/m01); suitability for an operation (quranic:root_000138:B002/m01); retained memory (quranic:root_000516:B003/m01); spoken mention (quranic:root_000516:B004/m01); reminder restoring presence (quranic:root_000516:B009/m01); gathered articulation (quranic:root_001210:B001/m01); recitation (quranic:root_001210:B002/m01); clear appearance (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01); semantic disclosure (quranic:root_000170:B005/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Poetry is excluded as the governing production mode, not because language lacks craft or perception. Fine awareness and signs remain, but recitation gathers them into a retained, speakable, and disclosing structure whose purpose is remembrance.

subchannels.name: Warning the living, fixing the verdict
subchannels.scene_or_process: Warning seeks a living, benefit-capable recipient; refusal covers the truth until the uttered verdict becomes fixed and manifest.
subchannels.active_motifs: danger-awakening warning (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); occurrence in time (quranic:root_001332:B001/m01); living being (quranic:root_000383:B003/m01); life as benefit and rescue (quranic:root_000383:B013/m01); truth matching reality (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); binding obligation (quranic:root_000347:B002/m01); truth made manifest (quranic:root_000347:B005/m01); spoken utterance (quranic:root_001272:B001/m01); a thing's own signification (quranic:root_001272:B014/m01); defining limit (quranic:root_001272:B016/m01); truth covered (quranic:root_001307:B003/m01); benefit covered (quranic:root_001307:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Life is defined functionally as remaining responsiveness and benefit. Warning addresses that openness; denial covers it, and the word then changes role from appeal to binding definition, fixing the denier's state in a verdict that matches what has become manifest.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The message gathers marks into intelligible remembrance and directs warning toward a recipient still capable of response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:69 distinguishes recitation and reminder from poetry, and 36:70 aims warning at the living while fixing the word against denial.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The rejected category of poetry still contributes fine perception and marking, but those components are subordinated to recitation's more explicit assembly and disclosure.

parent_channels.name: P5 - Service and Ownership Reversal

subchannels.name: Tamed livestock as a service chain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Created livestock passes under ownership, is made gently compliant and route-ready, and yields transport, food, drink, benefit, and visible increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeing and recognition (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); created production (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); manual workers (quranic:root_001046:B006/m01); owning hand (quranic:root_001693:B004/m01); livestock wealth (quranic:root_001525:B005/m01); property and control (quranic:root_001444:B002/m01); dominion (quranic:root_001444:B003/m01); gentle compliance (quranic:root_000519:B002/m01); taming after difficulty (quranic:root_000519:B003/m01); movement on a prepared course (quranic:root_000519:B004/m01); riding (quranic:root_000589:B001/m01); eating (quranic:root_000043:B001/m01); allotted food (quranic:root_000043:B003/m01); practical benefit (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01); drinking (quranic:root_000783:B001/m01); water share (quranic:root_000783:B002/m01); drinking place or vessel (quranic:root_000783:B004/m01); acknowledged favor (quranic:root_000810:B001/m01); visible yield from little input (quranic:root_000810:B002/m01); abundant milk (quranic:root_000810:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene forms a complete husbandry economy: production, ownership, taming, route, rider, food, water-allocation, vessel, and benefit. Gratitude mirrors the animal that turns a small ration into visible body and abundant milk, closing the chain with responsive increase.

subchannels.name: Gods that cannot perform reciprocal service
subchannels.scene_or_process: People acquire other worshiped objects for rescue, but those objects supply neither aid, rain, nor gift; instead the worshipers form the only army present to the arrangement.
subchannels.active_motifs: acquired possession (quranic:root_000018:B010/m01); subordinate others (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); worshiped object (quranic:root_000047:B001/m01); aid against an adversary (quranic:root_001510:B001/m01); rain-like rescue (quranic:root_001510:B004/m01); helping gift (quranic:root_001510:B005/m01); capacity for action (quranic:root_000956:B003/m01); mutually supporting army (quranic:root_000264:B001/m01); compelled presence (quranic:root_000333:B001/m01); mustered present group (quranic:root_000333:B007/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The ownership claim collapses under a service test. The gods cannot produce any mode of help, while the humans become the organized personnel attached to them. The relation reverses: those seeking servants are themselves the only mobilized servants.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Real control is demonstrated by making a dependent system useful, whereas imagined control reverses when supposed protectors cannot serve and their clients become their mustered force.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:71-73 gives created, owned, tamed livestock and their uses, while 36:74-75 gives adopted gods that cannot help and a present army attached to them.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gratitude is pictured as abundant milk after sparse feed, while false divine service exposes its worshipers as the only effective personnel in the arrangement.

parent_channels.name: P5 - Material Reconstitution

subchannels.name: Aging as inversion and relapse
subchannels.scene_or_process: Extended life turns an organized form downward, relapses vigor into weakness, bows head and sight, and impairs both reason and gait.
subchannels.active_motifs: extended lifespan (quranic:root_001044:B001/m01); top-to-bottom inversion (quranic:root_001551:B001/m01); relapse after recovery (quranic:root_001551:B003/m01); diminished vigor (quranic:root_001551:B005/m01); bowed head and sight (quranic:root_001551:B006/m01); measured form (quranic:root_000434:B001/m01); balanced bodily shape (quranic:root_000434:B003/m01); ingrained temperament (quranic:root_000434:B004/m01); reason that restrains folly (quranic:root_001036:B001/m01); impaired legs (quranic:root_001036:B009/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Aging is a systematic reversal, not a single loss. Duration turns upper to lower, recovered strength relapses, posture folds, gait degrades, and the reasoning faculty named as a restraint is itself placed under pressure.

subchannels.name: A drop becomes a manifest disputant
subchannels.scene_or_process: A flowing reproductive drop is measured into visible human form, acquires perception, and emerges as an articulate adversarial side.
subchannels.active_motifs: manifest human being (quranic:root_000059:B001/m01); perception by sight or hearing (quranic:root_000059:B002/m01); human image in the eye (quranic:root_000059:B005/m01); generative water-drop (quranic:root_001518:B002/m01); flowing and dripping fluid (quranic:root_001518:B003/m01); created production (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); completed bodily form (quranic:root_000434:B003/m01); adversarial disputant (quranic:root_000416:B001/m01); side or edge (quranic:root_000416:B002/m01); visible disclosure (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The transformation spans scale, medium, and social role. Fluid becomes bounded body, body becomes perceiving human, and the human takes a sharply defined adversarial side. The final disputant therefore manifests the very formative capacity he contests.

subchannels.name: Discarded bone repaired into life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker discards memory of his own formation and treats bone as worn fragments, but the same lexical field contains repair, re-creation, beginning, recurrence, and known return.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken parable (quranic:root_001397:B003/m01); example as instructive sign (quranic:root_001397:B011/m01); loss of retained memory (quranic:root_001501:B001/m01); abandonment (quranic:root_001501:B002/m01); discarded remnant (quranic:root_001501:B003/m01); worn created form (quranic:root_000434:B009/m01); solid bone (quranic:root_001029:B005/m01); repair of what has decayed (quranic:root_000601:B001/m01); dust and fragments (quranic:root_000601:B003/m01); decayed remains (quranic:root_000601:B004/m01); living being (quranic:root_000383:B003/m01); re-creation (quranic:root_001502:B006/m01); first beginning (quranic:root_000067:B001/m01); return to outcome (quranic:root_000067:B002/m01); recurrence in time (quranic:root_001414:B002/m01); encompassing knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The objection depends on classifying remains as discarded and irrecoverable. Yet the decay root also names repair of a wall or ruined affair; beginning and recurrence supply the temporal operation, and knowledge preserves the form that fragments no longer visibly display.

subchannels.name: Green wood converted to flame
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moist green growth and load-bearing wood are transformed into fuel, hearth, and active flame.
subchannels.active_motifs: change into a new state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); tree with a trunk (quranic:root_000777:B001/m01); load-bearing interlocked wood (quranic:root_000777:B004/m01); fresh green plant (quranic:root_000418:B002/m01); moist flourishing life (quranic:root_000418:B003/m01); burning fire (quranic:root_001564:B002/m01); tree blossom as light (quranic:root_001564:B004/m01); ignition (quranic:root_001672:B001/m01); fuel material (quranic:root_001672:B002/m01); hearth (quranic:root_001672:B003/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The materials appear incompatible because green growth carries moisture and flourishing life. The scene nevertheless supplies a conversion chain from tree structure to fuel, place of burning, and flame; even the tree's blossom contributes a latent light-bearing stage before combustion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Form can be inverted, generated from minimal fluid, repaired from fragments, or converted across apparently incompatible material states.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:68 reverses form through aging, 36:77 produces a disputant from a drop, 36:78-79 restores decayed bone, and 36:80 produces fire from green growth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Decay vocabulary also supplies repair, and wet flourishing wood becomes both fuel and light-bearing blossom.

parent_channels.name: P5 - Sovereign Actualization and Return

subchannels.name: Cosmic capacity by measured analogy
subchannels.scene_or_process: The maker who measured and produced sky and earth is tested by analogy for capacity to make their counterpart.
subchannels.active_motifs: overhead sky (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); earth below the sky (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01); measured design before action (quranic:root_000434:B001/m01); origination (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); effective capacity and possession (quranic:root_001205:B003/m01); measured planning (quranic:root_001205:B005/m01); likeness (quranic:root_001397:B001/m01); negation set aside (quranic:root_001390:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The analogy preserves operation rather than scale: measured design and origination have already produced the larger field, so capacity for a corresponding form follows from the demonstrated making relation.

subchannels.name: Performative command
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sovereign will selects an object, articulates an imperative, and the object occurs in time as the command's realized state.
subchannels.active_motifs: affair or state (quranic:root_000051:B001/m01); binding imperative (quranic:root_000051:B002/m01); governing authority (quranic:root_000051:B003/m01); directed will (quranic:root_000610:B001/m01); knowable object (quranic:root_000831:B001/m01); will attached to an object (quranic:root_000831:B002/m01); articulated utterance (quranic:root_001272:B001/m01); a thing's own signification (quranic:root_001272:B014/m01); occurrence in time (quranic:root_001332:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a complete performative sequence: authority possesses an affair, will selects its object, utterance gives the object a directive sign, and being is the temporal occurrence of that directive rather than a separate fabrication stage.

subchannels.name: Total custody and return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Power, ownership, and authority cohere in one hand that sustains the total domain and receives every thing back at its destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: transcendence from defect (quranic:root_000666:B002/m01); hand as power (quranic:root_001693:B002/m01); hand as ownership (quranic:root_001693:B004/m01); hand as executable authority (quranic:root_001693:B005/m01); cohesion that keeps a structure standing (quranic:root_001444:B001/m01); possession and disposal (quranic:root_001444:B002/m01); dominion and rule (quranic:root_001444:B003/m01); governing support of an affair (quranic:root_001444:B005/m01); encompassing totality (quranic:root_001315:B003/m01); return to origin (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01); destination and final outcome (quranic:root_000067:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The hand is not a single metaphorical feature but a convergence of force, possession, and enforceable rule. Dominion supplies the cohesion by which the whole remains a whole; return then closes custody by bringing each object to the outcome already contained within that rule.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The capacity that designs and commands forms also holds their total field together and determines their return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:81 argues from cosmic creation and capacity, 36:82 makes will and command produce being, and 36:83 locates all dominion in a powerful hand and directs all things back.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The command is simultaneously affair, imperative, authority, and road-marker; the hand is simultaneously power, ownership, and executable rule.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 - Mercy as a protective interior and repaired surface
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Awe before an unseen source is received into womb-like mercy, covered from damaging consequence, repaired, and made visibly glad and honored.
parent_channels.active_motifs: awe-filled fear (quranic:root_000413:B001/m01); hiddenness from sight (quranic:root_001117:B001/m01); preserving cover (quranic:root_001096:B001/m01); forgiveness shielding from consequence (quranic:root_001096:B002/m01); compassionate mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01); womb as protective interior (quranic:root_000552:B003/m01); news opening the skin with joy (quranic:root_000120:B005/m01); bestowed honor (quranic:root_001294:B001/m01); crooked break repaired (quranic:root_000015:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Mercy and forgiveness form a layered shelter: a womb-like interior receives the one who responds without sight, and a preserving cover blocks the aftereffects of fault. Reward contributes the concrete image of a badly set break repaired, while glad news and honor move the result outward onto the recipient's visible surface.

parent_channels.name: S2. P2 - Courier from the periphery
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A knowledgeable local crosses the distance from a city's far edge on foot, expends purposeful effort, and leads others toward an unpaid guide.
parent_channels.active_motifs: farthest edge (quranic:root_001235:B001/m01); walled collective city (quranic:root_001408:B001/m01); local who knows the city's affairs (quranic:root_001408:B004/m01); leg as locomotor member (quranic:root_000546:B001/m01); walking without a mount (quranic:root_000546:B003/m01); directed quick movement (quranic:root_000709:B001/m01); effort and work (quranic:root_000709:B002/m01); following in another's wake (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); wage returned for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); gentle route-guidance (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01); leading element at the front (quranic:root_001583:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene has a mapped origin, a pedestrian body, exertion, and a social destination. The courier's local knowledge and movement from the margin toward the center authorize his guidance, while refusal of wages removes a competing transactional motive from the route he recommends.

parent_channels.name: S3. P2 - One cry extinguishes a deployment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A potential heavenly military descent is withheld; one alarming signal replaces army and duel, quenching both flame and collective life.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mutually supporting army (quranic:root_000264:B001/m01); stony military ground (quranic:root_000264:B002/m01); overhead sky (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); delivered descent (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); descent into combat (quranic:root_001492:B007/m01); alarming cry (quranic:root_000895:B002/m01); numerical one (quranic:root_001631:B002/m01); flame stilled over embers (quranic:root_000437:B001/m01); life or awareness stilled after motion (quranic:root_000437:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The expected force package would descend from above, occupy hard ground, and enter combat. Instead a single acoustic event performs the entire operation without deployment: its result is described through fire whose flame has gone still and, by extension, a population whose animation has ceased.

parent_channels.name: S4. P3 - A cry seizes an unfinished social transfer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: People wait on a promised event while arguing; one cry captures them before testament, household transfer, or return can be completed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: promise opening expectation (quranic:root_001662:B001/m01); threat (quranic:root_001662:B002/m01); appointed time (quranic:root_001662:B003/m01); truthful statement (quranic:root_000852:B001/m01); fulfillment in action (quranic:root_000852:B004/m01); waiting for time (quranic:root_001520:B002/m01); alarming cry (quranic:root_000895:B002/m01); numerical one (quranic:root_001631:B002/m01); taking into possession (quranic:root_000018:B001/m01); capture (quranic:root_000018:B003/m01); adversarial dispute (quranic:root_000416:B001/m01); capacity for action (quranic:root_000956:B003/m01); connection of one thing to another (quranic:root_001656:B001/m01); testament transmitted onward (quranic:root_001656:B002/m01); household and kin (quranic:root_000064:B001/m01); return to an originating place (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Expectation is not resolved through deliberation. The event arrives as a seizure while social speech is still adversarial, cutting the connective operations by which property, instruction, and presence would pass to a household. The interruption is therefore temporal, bodily, and intergenerational at once.

parent_channels.name: S5. P5 - Hidden and public speech under knowledge
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Spoken claims produce grief, but unspoken inner content and public declaration occupy one field of complete knowledge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: roughened inner state of grief (quranic:root_000317:B001/m01); spoken utterance (quranic:root_001272:B001/m01); unspoken saying in the self (quranic:root_001272:B012/m01); disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); concealed inward matter (quranic:root_000697:B001/m01); pure inner core (quranic:root_000697:B005/m01); access to hidden affairs (quranic:root_000697:B014/m01); public manifestation (quranic:root_001041:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Speech is divided by visibility, not by knowability. Public utterance can roughen the hearer's interior, while unsaid content remains an inward saying with its own core; knowledge crosses both surfaces and removes the informational advantage of concealment.

parent_channels.name: S6. Skinning and tanning a measured hide
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hide is peeled from the body, kept hair-on when desired, and treated with a small measured charge of tanning bark or leaves.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hide stripped from a body (quranic:root_000729:B001/m01); hair retained on hide through skinning or tanning (quranic:root_000844:B006/m01); small measured dose of tannin (quranic:root_001533:B007/m01); acacia bark or leaves used for tanning (quranic:root_000737:B008/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This craft sequence reframes the stripping of day in 36:37 as the opening operation of a controlled material transformation. A removed covering need not be mere waste: measured treatment preserves it as usable hide, supporting the Surah's wider movement from exhausted or concealed matter into a new functional state.

parent_channels.name: S7. Stitching and seasoning a waterskin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Leather pieces are stitched into a vessel with side panels, weak apertures are found, clay and water are worked through the skin to seal its seams, and its mouth is tied shut.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stitching leather into a waterskin (quranic:root_001283:B001/m02); side panels of a leather water bag (quranic:root_001536:B002/m01); thin spot or leaking eye in a waterskin (quranic:root_001069:B007/m01); seasoning with clay and water to seal stitches (quranic:root_000783:B013/m01); tie closing the vessel's mouth (quranic:root_001678:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene materializes the Surah's springs, benefits, and drinking places as provision that can be carried. Water becomes reliably available only after separate pieces are joined, leaks are closed, taste is conditioned, and the opening is controlled.

parent_channels.name: S8. Drawing water through a timbered wellhead
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A timber-and-stone wellhead carries a rotating axle; a spliced, long-twisted rope reaches the water, bears a one-handled bucket by its lug, and passes between drawers taking turns.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stone and paired timbers at a wellhead (quranic:root_000547:B006/m01); rotating iron axle of a pulley (quranic:root_000610:B006/m01); rope splice extending a line to water (quranic:root_000471:B003/m01); long twisted well-rope (quranic:root_000796:B002/m02); one-handled drawing bucket (quranic:root_000737:B011/m01); bucket lug or load-balancing side piece (quranic:root_000741:B008/m01); water drawers alternating turns (quranic:root_000433:B011/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This apparatus supports the dead-earth and spring reading by making provision a vertical transfer rather than a bare appearance of water. The source may be given, but usable access still requires joined lengths, balanced load, rotation, and coordinated turn-taking.

parent_channels.name: S9. Gestation, birth, and afterbirth
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A womb encloses an inward pregnancy and hidden fetus; birth releases the child with blood and afterbirth, while the womb remains subject to postpartum pain.
parent_channels.active_motifs: womb as the enclosed growth chamber (quranic:root_000552:B003/m01); fetus hidden in the mother's abdomen (quranic:root_000266:B007/m01); inward pregnancy carried in the body (quranic:root_000357:B002/m01); child emergence with postpartum blood (quranic:root_001533:B005/m01); matter expelled with the child at birth (quranic:root_000822:B006/m01); postpartum pain or swelling of the womb (quranic:root_000552:B004/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The sequence supports the Surah's creation-and-return argument by making emergence from concealment a full bodily process: enclosure, formation, exit, residue, and continuing consequence. The disputant made from a drop is thus preceded by an unseen material history rather than appearing as an unmediated adult body.

parent_channels.name: S10. Timed milking and churned yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Milking is scheduled, approached from a designated side, and performed with the fingertips; retained milk draws the next flow, a full udder yields repeatedly, and churning gathers butter before the liquid thickens.
parent_channels.active_motifs: appointed time for milking (quranic:root_000382:B003/m01); milker positioned at a particular side (quranic:root_000170:B009/m01); fingertip milking (quranic:root_001165:B005/m01); milk left in the udder to draw the next flow (quranic:root_000478:B003/m01); full udder and abundant milk (quranic:root_000810:B003/m01); repeated flow of milk (quranic:root_000563:B006/m01); butter gathering in the skin or churn (quranic:root_000205:B004/m01); milk thickening at the end of processing (quranic:root_000067:B005/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene supports 36:71-73 by expanding livestock drink into a timed husbandry and processing chain. Possession alone does not produce nourishment: position, touch, retained yield, repeated flow, and churning cooperate before milk becomes a stable food, giving gratitude a concrete economy of care and work.

parent_channels.name: S11. Letting the young animal nurse or blocking its tongue
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A suckling young animal may be released with its mother to nurse freely, or fitted with a small rod or spindle-like piece on its tongue until nursing stops.
parent_channels.active_motifs: young animal sent with its mother to nurse at will (quranic:root_000546:B014/m01); tongue device preventing a young animal from suckling (quranic:root_001177:B006/m01); withholding and weaning from a desired thing (quranic:root_000994:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This husbandry choice usefully pressures the statement that humans drink from livestock in 36:73. The human benefit is produced by deciding whether maternal milk reaches the offspring or is redirected, so domestication appears as an intervention into feeding rather than neutral availability.

parent_channels.name: S12. Lowering the cooking pot and feeding a guest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Food is cooked in a pot, the hot vessel is lowered from the fire with a protective cloth, its contents pass to an eating bowl, and the prepared meal is offered to a guest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot and the cook who tends it (quranic:root_001205:B007/m01); cloth used to lower a hot pot (quranic:root_000248:B007/m01); bowl or vessel from which food is eaten (quranic:root_000043:B013/m01); gathered food offered in hospitality (quranic:root_001222:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene materializes the Surah's grain, fruit, eating, and hospitality as one social conversion. Growth becomes nourishment through heat and careful handling, then becomes welcome only when the finished food crosses from cooking vessel to guest.

parent_channels.name: S13. Facing, standing, and completing prayer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper deliberately turns toward a prayer direction, stands, completes the sequence of standing, bowing, and prostration, and joins bodily obedience to praise.
parent_channels.active_motifs: deliberate aiming and orientation (quranic:root_000053:B012/m01); direction faced in prayer (quranic:root_001198:B005/m01); bodily standing (quranic:root_001273:B002/m01); formal prayer with standing, bowing, and prostration (quranic:root_000880:B001/m01); praise enacted as prayer (quranic:root_000666:B001/m01); obedient worship (quranic:root_000973:B003/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This rite supports 36:61 by turning worship on a straight path into calibrated bodily orientation. Intention selects a direction, standing establishes the body's axis, and the completed movements make obedience and praise spatially enacted rather than only inward assent.

parent_channels.name: S14. A staked race with a ranked finish
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Competitors race for a named stake; one advances first, a second horse follows close behind, and a third completes the ranked order.
parent_channels.active_motifs: racing advance (quranic:root_000671:B001/m01); prize or stake set for a race (quranic:root_000671:B002/m01); second horse following the winner (quranic:root_000880:B007/m01); horse arriving third in the race (quranic:root_000203:B003/m02)
parent_channels.synthesis: The race script usefully pressures 36:40: ordinary racing expects a stake, overtaking, and ranks produced by displacement. The verse denies that competitive outcome between sun and moon, converting shared motion from a contest for precedence into coordinated traffic.

parent_channels.name: S15. Earning release through a written manumission
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person held as transferable property enters a written emancipation contract and works through its assessed payments until ownership is dissolved and the neck is freed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: property held under an owner's control (quranic:root_001444:B002/m01); person owned as a slave (quranic:root_000973:B001/m01); action of reducing a person to servitude (quranic:root_000973:B004/m01); written manumission contract with staged payments (quranic:root_001283:B005/m01); slave's earnings applied to the price of release (quranic:root_000709:B005/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This social transaction usefully pressures a flat equation of worship with chattel slavery. Worldly bondage has an owner, a price, a written schedule, and a negotiated exit; 36:60-61 instead frames worship as covenantal allegiance whose direction is the straight path.

parent_channels.name: S16. Struck lute and modulated song
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wooden lute or similar instrument is struck with its implement while a singer shapes a pleasurable vocal line through repeated, modulated phrases received in listening.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wooden lute or struck musical instrument (quranic:root_001058:B010/m01); implement used to strike a lute (quranic:root_000906:B014/m01); singing voice and song (quranic:root_001110:B003/m01); vocal modulation in reading, song, or the call to prayer (quranic:root_000544:B007/m01); pleasurable sung sound and its performer (quranic:root_000741:B007/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The performance scene usefully pressures a purely acoustic reading of the denial of poetry in 36:69. Returned vocal phrasing can belong to recitation, the call to prayer, or song, while instrument, striking tool, singer, and pleasurable listening complete a distinct entertainment frame; the reminder is therefore distinguished by communicative function, not by an absence of patterned sound.

parent_channels.name: S17. Kindling, feeding, and quenching a fire
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A rod is worked inside a hollow fire-stick until it catches; the resulting sparks are tested for usefulness, fuel is fed to the flame, and embers are finally buried to make the fire die down.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hollow fire-stick receiving a kindling rod (quranic:root_000697:B008/m01); fire-stick catching rapidly (quranic:root_001672:B005/m01); weak unusable sparks (quranic:root_000286:B011/m01); fire consuming fed wood (quranic:root_000043:B005/m01); ember-burying place for quenching fire (quranic:root_000437:B004/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene directly materializes 36:80 beyond the first appearance of flame from green wood. Latent heat becomes usable fire through fitted tools, successful ignition, spark discrimination, and added fuel; burial of the embers then shows the same force brought back under control.

parent_channels.name: S18. Grave concealment and the tethered burial camel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The dead person is shrouded and hidden in a grave marked by gathered stones, while a camel is tethered beside its owner and denied food and water until it too dies.
parent_channels.active_motifs: shrouding and burying the dead (quranic:root_000266:B009/m01); concealing a body in a grave (quranic:root_001117:B009/m01); piled grave stones (quranic:root_000547:B005/m01); grave-camel tethered without food or water (quranic:root_000154:B006/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 36:11 `بالغيب`; 36:18 `لنرجمنكم`; 36:26,34,55 `الجنة`, `جنات`; surface anchor unavailable for root `ب ل ي`
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite usefully pressures the grave-exit of 36:51. Human burial conceals the body, fixes its place with stone, and extends death to a living possession beside it; the horn reverses that whole arrangement by making grave-bound bodies mobile at once.

parent_channels.name: S19. Spinning, weaving, and seaming a covering
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A spindle whorl turns and twists yarn; opposed strands are joined according to a weaving model, woven firmly, and sewn edge to edge into a strong finished cloth.
