parent_channels.active_motifs: spindle whorl (quranic:root_001177:B005/m01); joined opposing yarn elements (quranic:root_001198:B010/m01); model on which cloth is woven (quranic:root_000906:B007/m01); well-spun and tightly woven fabric (quranic:root_000217:B007/m01); seam joining two cloth edges (quranic:root_000121:B006/m01); strong cloth made from abundant yarn (quranic:root_000043:B012/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This fabrication sequence reframes 36:37 by supplying the reverse operation to stripping away a covering. Aligned strands, a governing pattern, tight interlacing, and closed seams produce the surface that stripping would remove, making the day-night reversal legible as an undoing of organized material.

parent_channels.name: S20. Estimating and raising a timbered frame
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A builder estimates the needed masonry, shapes wood with an adze, joins the structure, raises its supports, seats the pillar head under cross-timbers, lays transverse beams, and closes remaining gaps.
parent_channels.active_motifs: estimating the number of bricks needed (quranic:root_000950:B007/m01); adze used to carve wood (quranic:root_001207:B008/m01); building by joining parts (quranic:root_000156:B001/m01); house supports and pillars (quranic:root_000156:B009/m01); timbers carrying a pillar head (quranic:root_001222:B008/m01); transverse roof or door beam (quranic:root_001001:B013/m01); material used to close an opening (quranic:root_000687:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene materializes the barrier of 36:9 as an engineered closure. Estimation, cutting, joining, bracing, spanning, and plugging turn obstruction from a bare object into the outcome of a measured construction sequence.

parent_channels.name: S21. Fitting, drawing, and delivering an arrow
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A smooth shaft receives its point, waits in a quiver joined to the bow, is taken by hand, set against the bow limb, drawn to the limit, and sent to its intended endpoint.
parent_channels.active_motifs: smoothed arrow shaft (quranic:root_000434:B008/m01); arrowhead fitted into its shaft (quranic:root_000589:B004/m01); quiver joined to a bow (quranic:root_001221:B007/m01); hand reaching into the quiver for an arrow (quranic:root_000544:B010/m01); bow limb (quranic:root_000546:B009/m01); bow drawn to its fullest extent (quranic:root_001080:B004/m01); arrow or message reaching its target or addressee (quranic:root_001560:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The final motif makes directed delivery the invariant shared by projectile and report. The assembled bow scene therefore usefully pressures the Surah's sent-message reading: a warning reaches an addressee by intelligible speech, while the surrounding threats imagine directed force reaching a body.

parent_channels.name: S22. Moonlit hunting and verifying the kill
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters go out under moonlight when prey vision is compromised, set snares or use a feeding bow or trained raptor, strike successive animals, and inspect the fallen quarry to determine whether it has died.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hunters setting out in pursuit (quranic:root_000745:B006/m01); moonlit hunting against visually impaired prey (quranic:root_001255:B003/m01); snares and traps set for game (quranic:root_000880:B005/m01); hunting tool or raptor that feeds its owner (quranic:root_000934:B006/m01); successive prey taken in one discharge (quranic:root_000993:B008/m01); inspection to establish whether prey is dead (quranic:root_001454:B014/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The hunt ends not with self-evident death but with a human examination of an uncertain body. That uncertainty usefully pressures 36:79: the hunter must infer whether life has ceased, whereas the one who first created the body knows its state and can restore it.

parent_channels.name: S23. A wound that suppurates, heals, and relapses
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A boil or ulcer emerges, fills with pus, swells and spreads toward corruption, then settles as healthy flesh reappears, yet remains capable of returning to a worse state.
parent_channels.active_motifs: boil or ulcer emerging from the body (quranic:root_000400:B004/m01); pus accumulated in a wound (quranic:root_000282:B003/m01); wound swelling and spreading into corruption (quranic:root_000138:B004/m01); swelling subsiding as healthy flesh appears (quranic:root_000026:B005/m01); wound relapsing after improvement (quranic:root_001096:B004/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The bodily sequence supports the Surah's repair imagery while marking the limits of ordinary repair. Human tissue can reorganize and look sound, but the improvement remains reversible; renewed creation in 36:78-81 is presented as decisive rather than a precarious remission.

parent_channels.name: S24. Protecting, ripening, and gathering dates
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Palms stand in planted rows; the blossom and young fruit remain sheathed, the first dates ripen and acquire flavor, the crop becomes accessible to picking, and fresh fruit is gathered into a woven palm-leaf basket before gleanings remain after harvest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: palms planted in rows (quranic:root_000589:B009/m01); sheath enclosing palm blossom or fruit (quranic:root_001307:B010/m01); first ripe dates appearing (quranic:root_000120:B007/m01); fruit reaching maturity and flavor (quranic:root_000934:B005/m01); ripe palm fruit ready to gather (quranic:root_000956:B007/m01); woven palm-leaf basket for fresh dates (quranic:root_000464:B010/m01); fallen gleanings and dry dates after harvest (quranic:root_000239:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene directly supports the palms and fruit of 36:34-35 by restoring their temporal and material chain. Sheathing and ripening belong to growth, while picking, basketry, and gleaning belong to human handling; the distinction sharpens the Surah's refusal to treat produced life as simply the work of human hands.

parent_channels.name: S25. Opening, administering, and discharging an oath
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker invokes the divine name, opens an oath with its confirming particle, swears, may administer the oath to reassure or test another person, narrows its scope by exception, and answers breach with expiation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: divine name used in an oath formula (quranic:root_000047:B002/m01); confirming particle that opens an oath (quranic:root_000074:B010/m01); oath and swearing (quranic:root_000076:B007/m01); oath administered for reassurance or testing (quranic:root_000154:B005/m01); exception removing one item from an oath's scope (quranic:root_000208:B008/m01); expiation covering a broken oath (quranic:root_001307:B009/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 36:14 `اثنين`; 36:23,47,74 forms of `الله`, `آلهة`; 36:33,37,41,46 `آية`, `آيات`; 36:47,64,70 forms of `كفر`; surface anchors unavailable for roots `ء ل ي` and `ب ل ي`
parent_channels.synthesis: The social frame supports the oath that opens the Surah by treating sworn speech as an accountable act rather than ornament. Invocation, confirmation, administration, exception, and expiation trace how an utterance creates an obligation and how its failure must be answered.

parent_channels.name: S26. Appraising and closing a cash sale
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Merchandise is exposed for inspection, assigned a price, paid for in present full-weight coin handed directly between parties, and carried through as a completed sale.
parent_channels.active_motifs: merchandise displayed for sale (quranic:root_001001:B002/m01); appraisal and pricing of goods (quranic:root_001273:B010/m01); coin at exact standard weight (quranic:root_001273:B015/m01); ready cash rather than absent debt (quranic:root_001069:B011/m01); hand-to-hand cash payment (quranic:root_001693:B007/m01); sale ratified and allowed to proceed (quranic:root_001430:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The transaction reframes the Surah's repeated hands through an ordinary mechanism of acquisition. A hand can close an exchange and establish possession, but 36:35 denies that such hands made the fruit, and 36:65 reverses their commercial agency by making them testify about their owner.

parent_channels.name: S27. Contracting a marriage and establishing a household
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is contracted, the bride-price is assigned, the bride is conveyed to her husband, a wedding shelter is raised for entry into married life, and a new household relation is established.
parent_channels.active_motifs: witnessed marriage contract (quranic:root_001444:B004/m01); bride-price (quranic:root_000852:B007/m01); bride conveyed to her husband (quranic:root_001583:B006/m01); wedding shelter and entry into marriage (quranic:root_000156:B006/m01); taking a spouse and forming a household (quranic:root_000064:B002/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The sequence materializes the pairing of 36:36 and the spouses of 36:56 as a social passage rather than abstract symmetry. Contract, gift, transfer, shelter, and household convert two persons into a publicly situated pair.

parent_channels.name: S28. Warranty, surety, and recourse
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A written purchase warranty preserves recourse for defects; liability follows the transaction, a guarantor or surety assumes the right or fine, and a claimant invokes the obligation against the responsible party.
parent_channels.active_motifs: written purchase warranty and defect condition (quranic:root_001055:B006/m01); liability following a sale (quranic:root_000471:B004/m01); guarantor's undertaking (quranic:root_001198:B008/m01); surety carrying a right or fine (quranic:root_000357:B004/m01); claimant pursuing money or another right (quranic:root_000175:B005/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: This legal sequence materializes the Surah's record and settlement language in 36:12 and 36:54. Human recourse needs a deed, allocated liability, a substitute bearer, and an active claimant; eschatological settlement retains exact obligation while removing dependence on those fallible intermediaries.

parent_channels.name: S29. Divorce, family return, and renewed courtship
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Divorce may sever the right of marital return or permit reconciliation; the woman may instead return to her family, after which suitors communicate with her as a widow or divorcee.
parent_channels.active_motifs: irrevocable divorce cutting off marital return (quranic:root_000170:B012/m01); husband taking his wife back after divorce (quranic:root_000544:B004/m01); woman returning to her family after divorce or widowhood (quranic:root_000544:B004/m02); suitors corresponding with a widowed or divorced woman (quranic:root_000563:B009/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene sharpens the interruption in 36:50. Return to one's family is normally a meaningful social transition after a household bond ends, and renewed correspondence can open another future; the seizing cry cancels even that available route before it can begin.

parent_channels.name: Signal efficacy across state change
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A directed signal joins source, transmission, recipient, and outcome, while its efficacy is measured by the state change produced in the addressed field.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:2-11 and 36:13-29 establish transmitted warning, 36:48-53 moves through seizing cry and gathering blast, 36:69-70 restores the warning function, and 36:82 makes uttered command coincide with realized being.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The recipient progresses from responsible hearer to seized population, reassembled collective, and commanded object; acoustic or verbal form stays recognizable while causal force changes scale.
parent_channels.synthesis: The same source-signal-recipient-outcome architecture governs all five pericopes. Human response matters at the warning stage, but later signals progressively remove delay and negotiation: one arrests, one gathers, and one actualizes.

parent_channels.name: Route agency and compelled return
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A route scene couples orientation, a readable course, capacity for motion, impediment, and destination; its decisive variable is who controls passage.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:4-9 sets straightness against bodily and visual obstruction, 36:20-21 gives purposeful pedestrian traversal, 36:38-40 assigns measured celestial courses, 36:60-67 contrasts covenantal direction with diversion and erased passage, and 36:83 fixes final return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Straightness is not merely a quality of a path. It is a relation among bodily posture, sight, motive, traffic rules, allegiance, and the authority that fixes an endpoint.
parent_channels.synthesis: Every placement preserves course, mover, constraint, and destination, but redistributes control. The courier chooses and the celestial bodies remain regulated; the tethered or erased body loses navigational power; final return closes the progression by making destination certain even when creaturely route-choice has ended.

parent_channels.name: Reconstitution from inactivity and dispersal
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A still, absent, dispersed, or fragmented substrate is acted upon until organized agency becomes present again.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:12 announces revival, 36:28-32 moves from extinguished generations to total presence, 36:33-34 revives dead ground, 36:51-53 releases and gathers grave-bound bodies, and 36:77-81 argues from first formation and broken bone to renewed embodiment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Population, soil, fetus-like formation, and bone are not merged into one material class; they share an operation in which lost organization is answered by gathering, growth, repair, or renewed motion.
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is procedural rather than topical. Each pericope stages a before-state lacking active organized presence, an effective intervention, and an after-state whose agency is visible, so ecological revival and bodily return become mutually clarifying demonstrations of reconstitution.

parent_channels.name: Custody becoming obligation and account
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Receiving control over a deed, load, resource, dependent being, or person creates an obligation whose outcome exposes whether custody served transfer, use, withholding, or release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 36:12 preserves deeds and traces, 36:41 makes descendants entrusted cargo, 36:47 tests provision through expenditure, 36:54 and 36:65 attach settlement and testimony to action, and 36:71-75 tests ownership by service and reciprocal aid.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Custody never remains static possession. Record, cargo, food, livestock, bodily action, and bonded labor each reveal control through what the holder preserves, transfers, yields, withholds, or permits to leave.
parent_channels.synthesis: The progression turns possession into responsibility. Entrusted things generate claims on their holders; account makes those claims legible, while failed protection and contractual release reverse the assumption that control is proved simply by retaining another being.
